lead_headline: 23rd Lycian Way Walk Held in Kaş
lead_deck: Regional culture promoted alongside the Patara Yörük Migration event.
lead_body: The 23rd Lycian Way Walk and Patara Yörük Migration event, organised by Kaş Municipality, took place.
As part of the event, visitors were introduced to traditional Yörük culture while walking the region's historical routes.
